race.comment: MEMPHIS TENNESSEE (4) didn't make an impact at his last run before going for a spell on May 8, finishing sixth and beaten 4.5 lengths over 1600m at Canberra. Rates highly and makes plenty of appeal. SIYAASI (1) was well in commission last start over 1400m at Albury when third, beaten 6 lengths. Goes well over this trip, filling a placing at all four starts, including a win and has to be respected. ANCHOR DOWN (2) is back from a break of six months. Raced below par at his only appearance last prep when eleventh over 1200m at Yarra Valley. Settles back early but winds up late. Can take a hand in the finish. FOUR ESSES (9) scored her maiden win last time out at Narrandera and is looking an each-way chance.
